name: @cloudflare/playwright
description: Playwright for Cloudflare Browser Run (formerly Browser Rendering)

scripts.build:patched: npm run build:patched --workspace @cloudflare/browser-test-runtime && npm run build:types && npx vite build
scripts.test:generate:worker:patched: node ./utils/generate_worker_tests.js && cd tests && npx vite build
scripts.test:prepare:built: npm run test:generate:worker && npm run ci:tests
scripts.test:bundle: npm run test:prepare:built && cd tests && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.test:deploy: npm run test:prepare:built && cd tests && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.test:dev: npm run test:generate:worker && npm run ci:tests && cd tests && npx wrangler dev
scripts.test:full: npm run test:generate:proxy && cd tests && npx playwright test
scripts.test:smoke: npm run test:generate:proxy && cd tests && npx playwright test --grep "@smoke"
